name: WF-454 — Lead Generation Execution → Campaign/Channel Dispatch & Lead Intake Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const period=String(b.period??'').trim(); const executionId=String(b.executionId??b.requestId??'').trim(); const campaignId=String(b.campaignId??'').trim(); const channel=String(b.channel??'').trim().toLowerCase(); const requestedLeadVolume=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(b.requestedLeadVolume??b.leadVolume??0))); const approvedBudget=Math.max(0,Number(b.approvedBudget??b.budget??0)); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,period,executionId,campaignId,channel,requestedLeadVolume,approvedBudget,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Lead Generation Execution').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const flags=[]; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const executionApproved=ctx.executionApproved===true||['approved','authorized','approved_for_execution'].includes(String(ctx.executionState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase()); const campaignActive=ctx.campaignActive!==false; const channelAllowed=ctx.channelAllowed!==false; const budgetAvailable=n(ctx.availableBudget??ctx.remainingBudget); const leadCapacity=n(ctx.availableLeadCapacity??ctx.availableCapacity); const consentPolicyOk=ctx.consentPolicyOk!==false; const requestedBudget=input.approvedBudget; const requestedLeads=input.requestedLeadVolume; if(!executionApproved)flags.push('execution_not_approved'); if(!campaignActive)flags.push('campaign_inactive'); if(!channelAllowed)flags.push('channel_not_allowed'); if(!consentPolicyOk)flags.push('consent_policy_block'); if(budgetAvailable>0&&requestedBudget>budgetAvailable)flags.push('insufficient_budget'); if(leadCapacity>0&&requestedLeads>leadCapacity)flags.push('lead_capacity_exceeded'); const allowed=flags.length===0&&executionApproved&&campaignActive&&channelAllowed&&consentPolicyOk; const expectedCPL=n(ctx.expectedCostPerLead??ctx.cpl); const projectedLeadSpend=expectedCPL>0?Math.round(requestedLeads*expectedCPL*100)/100:requestedBudget; const utilization=requestedBudget>0?Math.round(projectedLeadSpend/requestedBudget*10000)/100:0; let decision='hold_lead_generation_dispatch',nextAction='resolve_execution_campaign_channel_or_capacity_block'; if(allowed){decision='dispatch_campaign_and_activate_lead_intake';nextAction='activate_campaign_dispatch_and_route_incoming_leads_to_insula_crm';} const idempotencyKey='wf454:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.period+':'+input.executionId; return [{json:{...input,leadGenerationDispatch:{status:allowed?'ready':'blocked',decision,nextAction,executionApproved,campaignActive,channelAllowed,consentPolicyOk,requestedLeadVolume:requestedLeads,approvedBudget:requestedBudget,projectedLeadSpend,expectedCostPerLead:expectedCPL,budgetUtilizationPercent:utilization,availableBudget,availableLeadCapacity,flags,dispatchAllowed:allowed,requiresHumanReview:!allowed,confidenceScore:allowed?90:30},idempotencyKey}}];

main.node: Validate Campaign Channel & Lead Intake Dispatch

meta.notes: Dispatches an approved acquisition execution into a campaign/channel and activates lead-intake routing only after execution approval, campaign/channel eligibility, consent policy and capacity checks pass. Production use requires verified campaign-platform integrations, consent/compliance rules, lead-intake schema and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
